description: This file defines the SimpleAudioOutput class, which provides a basic implementation for audio output using Android's AudioTrack API. It includes methods to create, start, stop, and write audio data to the track, primarily for experimental or example purposes.

classes.name: SimpleAudioOutput
classes.description: A class to handle simple audio output using Android's AudioTrack. It allows creating and managing audio playback with configurable frame rates.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts audio playback at the specified frame rate.

methods.name: createAudioTrack
methods.description: Creates an AudioTrack instance with the specified frame rate.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes PCM float data to the audio track buffer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops audio playback and releases resources.
